layout.body:
Award Winner Returns to Alma Mater
By Kevin Martin
Students were stunned when actor Daniel Rivero, famous for his award-winning role in Horizon's Edge, visited Ashburn College on Monday.
Rivero, a recent graduate of the Theater Arts program, returned to lead an impromptu drama workshop. Students crowded the theater hall, snapping selfies with the star and asking about his journey from Ashburn to Hollywood.
"I skipped lunch just to hear him," said sophomore Lily Chen. Rivero shared stories from his early auditions, including moments of rejection that taught him resilience.
"Embrace failure—it's the doorway to invention," he told students. He also praised Ashburn's faculty for fostering his love of storytelling. "It feels like I never left," he added.
The visit sparked excitement across campus, with social media flooded by photos from the workshop. For many students, it was a reminder that big dreams can start in small classrooms.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the article?

options.A: A graduating student is given a role in a Hollywood film.
options.B: A college campus is the backdrop of a Hollywood film.
options.C: A film screening on campus draws a large crowd.
options.D: A celebrated alumnus reconnects with his college.

questions.analysis: What is the main topic of the article? 原文依据：actor Daniel Rivero… visited Ashburn College / Rivero, a recent graduate… returned to lead an impromptu drama workshop. 翻译：获奖演员丹尼尔・里韦罗回访母校阿什本学院，开展戏剧分享活动，与在校学生互动交流。 选项分析： (A) A graduating student is given a role in a Hollywood film. 一名应届生获得好莱坞电影角色 → 错误，无原文依据 (B) A college campus is the backdrop of a Hollywood film. 大学校园为好莱坞电影取景地 → 错误，文中无相关内容 (C) A film screening on campus draws a large crowd. 校园电影放映吸引大量人群 → 错误，全文未提及电影放映 (D) A celebrated alumnus reconnects with his college. 知名校友重返母校、维系校园联结 → 正确，贴合全文主旨

questions.stem: What did Daniel Rivero do at Ashburn?

options.A: He gave an interview to the student newspaper.
options.B: He held auditions for his latest film.
options.C: He taught an unscheduled acting class.
options.D: He announced his role in an upcoming film.

questions.analysis: What did Daniel Rivero do at Ashburn? 原文依据：returned to lead an impromptu drama workshop. 翻译：返校主持一场即兴戏剧研习课。 选项分析： (A) He gave an interview to the student newspaper. 接受校报采访 → 错误，原文未提及 (B) He held auditions for his latest film. 为新电影举办试镜 → 错误，无相关描述 (C) He taught an unscheduled acting class. 开展一场临时的表演课程 → 正确，impromptu=unscheduled，drama workshop 对应表演课程 (D) He announced his role in an upcoming film. 官宣新电影角色 → 错误，文中没有相关内容

questions.stem: What is the meaning of Daniel Rivero’s advice to students?

options.A: Creative thinking begins when things go wrong.
options.B: It is good to leave home, but come back often.
options.C: Poor choices can stifle innovation if you are not careful.
options.D: Dream big and do not let anyone stand in your way.

questions.analysis: What is the meaning of Daniel Rivero’s advice to students? 原文依据："Embrace failure—it's the doorway to invention," he told students. 翻译：他告诉学生：“拥抱失败 —— 它是通往创造的大门。” 选项分析： (A) Creative thinking begins when things go wrong. 当事情不顺时，创造性思维才会开启 → 正确，与 “失败是发明之门” 直接对应，失败对应 “things go wrong”，发明 / 创造对应 “creative thinking”。 (B) It is good to leave home, but come back often. 离家虽好，但要常回来 → 错误，这是关于 “回归” 的话题，与他的建议无关。 (C) Poor choices can stifle innovation if you are not careful. 不小心的错误选择会扼杀创新 → 错误，这与原文鼓励拥抱失败的态度完全相反。 (D) Dream big and do not let anyone stand in your way. 大胆追梦，不要让任何人阻碍你 → 错误，文中未提及 “追梦” 和 “阻碍”，这是过度引申，并非他这句话的直接含义。
